description: Codex pre-built hooks and sandbox restrictions replicating I2.2 enforcement

action.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CODEX_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "rm -rf|git push.*--force|:(){ :|:& };"; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected" && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CODEX_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git commit"; then FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null || echo ""); for f in $FILES; do if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qiE "(api[_-]?key|secret|password|token)[\s:=\"]+[\w\-_]{16,}" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCKED: Potential secret detected in $f" && exit 2; fi; done; fi'
